proposed_change: Add automated SQL injection and hardcoded key scanner rule
impact_analysis: Zero breaking changes; adds pre-commit validation layer

proposed_change: Add CORESENTINEL:SCANNER-FIXTURES opt-out marker (opening 20 lines only) so scanner test-fixture files are exempt from secret/anti-pattern scanning; every skip is logged
evidence: Self-test suite commit: 8 false-positive violations raised against tests/security, tests/verification and tests/integration fixture files that exist solely to prove the scanner catches those patterns
impact_analysis: Medium risk; narrows scan scope. Mitigations: marker must appear in the first 20 lines, every exemption is printed in scan output, and 5 tests cover the mechanism including a buried-marker bypass attempt

proposed_change: Add the Memory Ecosystem Protocol: confidence decay (0.05 per 30 unverified days, floor 0.30, failures and pinned facts exempt), tiered promotion with an opt-in transferable gate for the project-to-core hop, duplicate consolidation that keeps max confidence rather than boosting, and budgeted compaction. Every operation is a dry run until --apply and snapshots before destroying.
evidence: Recorded facts had no expiry, no dedup and no search: 436-test suite (131 new) covers decay idempotence, promotion scope containment, no-confidence-manufacture on merge and snapshot reversibility
impact_analysis: Medium risk; decay mutates stored confidence. Mitigations: opt-in --apply on every operation, automatic pre-operation snapshots with restore, decay computed from base_confidence so it is idempotent, and re-verification requires an explicit match string

proposed_change: Make Standing Rule 7 platform-conditional instead of unconditionally Windows. Current text mandates 'PowerShell 5.1, not bash. python, never python3. No && / || / ternaries' for all agents on all projects. Replace with a rule that resolves the shell and interpreter from the host OS at session start, and states the Windows constraints as the Windows branch only, with a macOS/Linux branch specifying zsh/bash and python3.
evidence: Session 2026-08-15 on darwin 24.6.0: every CoreSentinel invocation required python3 (python is absent), zsh is the shell, and && is required. Rule 7 as written was wrong for 100 percent of commands in this session. Corroborating prior incidents already in 55-self-evolution.md: the 2026-08-10 anti-pattern where install.sh probed HOME/Desktop which does not exist under OneDrive redirection, and the 2026-08-10 sed Windows-path anti-pattern - both are cases of a platform assumption baked into a rule producing silent wrongness on the other platform.
impact_analysis: Low risk; the rule is advisory guidance to agents, not an executable control. No code path reads it. Mitigation: the Windows constraints are preserved verbatim as the Windows branch, so nothing is lost for Windows sessions. Failure mode if wrong: an agent uses the wrong interpreter name and the command errors loudly at once, which is self-correcting.
